description: Shared UI rendered by core: the /menu context / dropdown menu (--km-menu-*) and the phone sheet chrome every sheet uses (--km-sheet-*: header, title, close button). Each value (likewise --_km-sheet-X / --km-sheet-X) reads var(--_km-menu-X, var(--km-menu-X, var(--base-…, <default>))): the component's per-instance variable (mapped by the component onto the private --_km-menu-X with no fallback) wins, then the page-wide --km-menu-X (set on :root; components never set it), then the --base-* theme, then the default.

baseVariables.name: base-main-bg
baseVariables.usage: Menu background when neither dropdown nor elevated bg is set

baseVariables.name: base-border-color
baseVariables.usage: Menu border colour (without --base-dropdown-border) and divider colour

baseVariables.name: base-text-color-3
baseVariables.usage: Shortcut hint and divider label colour

baseVariables.name: base-disabled-opacity
baseVariables.usage: Disabled item and loading row opacity

baseVariables.name: base-danger-color
baseVariables.usage: Danger item text colour; tints the danger hover background

baseVariables.name: base-primary-color
baseVariables.usage: Toggled-on item colour (→ --km-menu-toggled-color); the sheet close button focus ring

baseVariables.name: base-touch-target-min
baseVariables.usage: Phone sheet row and close button minimum size (default 44px)

baseVariables.name: base-rem
baseVariables.usage: Rem base for every unitless size token below (default 10px)

baseVariables.name: base-space-sm
baseVariables.usage: Item gap, sheet row vertical padding, sheet header gap / block padding / close edge nudge (× --base-rem, default 0.8)

baseVariables.name: base-space-md
baseVariables.usage: Item and named divider horizontal padding (× --base-rem, default 1.2)

baseVariables.name: base-space-base
baseVariables.usage: Sheet row and sheet header horizontal padding (× --base-rem, default 1.6)

baseVariables.name: base-border-radius-sm
baseVariables.usage: Menu and sheet close button radius (× --base-rem, default 0.4)

baseVariables.name: base-z-tooltip
baseVariables.usage: Menu and sheet stacking: one above it (default 9000)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-z-index
componentVariables.usage: Menu and phone sheet stacking order (default calc(--base-z-tooltip + 1) = 9001, the phone-sheet tier)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-item-gap
componentVariables.usage: Gap between icon, label, shortcut and submenu arrow (→ --base-space-sm, default 8px)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-item-padding
componentVariables.usage: Item padding; also the loading row (default 0.6 rem --base-space-md = 6px 12px)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-hover-bg
componentVariables.usage: Item hover / focus / open-submenu background (→ --base-hover-bg, default 8% of currentColor)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-hover-color
componentVariables.usage: Item text colour on hover / focus / open submenu (default unchanged; danger and toggled items keep theirs)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-disabled-opacity
componentVariables.usage: Disabled item and loading row opacity (→ --base-disabled-opacity, default 0.65)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-danger-hover-bg
componentVariables.usage: Danger item hover background (→ --base-danger-bg-subtle, default 10% of the danger colour)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-submenu-arrow
componentVariables.usage: Submenu arrow glyph, a CSS content value (default "\25B8")

componentVariables.name: km-menu-sheet-border-radius
componentVariables.usage: Phone sheet corner radius (→ --base-border-radius-lg on the top corners, default 8px 8px 0 0)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-sheet-item-min-height
componentVariables.usage: Phone sheet row minimum height (→ --base-touch-target-min, default 44px)

componentVariables.name: km-menu-back-arrow
componentVariables.usage: Phone sheet Back row glyph, a CSS content value (default "\2039")

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-header-gap
componentVariables.usage: Gap between the header's title / fields and the close button (→ --base-space-sm, default 8px)

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-header-padding-block
componentVariables.usage: Header top / bottom padding; the close button's tap area reaches it (→ --base-space-sm, default 8px)

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-header-padding-inline
componentVariables.usage: Header start / end padding (lines the title up with the sheet rows); the close button's tap area reaches it (→ --base-space-base, default 16px)

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-close-icon
componentVariables.usage: Close icon, a mask image (→ --base-icon-close, default the base ✕)

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-close-border
componentVariables.usage: Close chip border (default none; with a radius and a bg it reads as a bordered button)

componentVariables.name: km-sheet-close-edge-nudge
componentVariables.usage: How far the close button slides past the header padding toward the edge (→ --base-space-sm, default 8px)
